summary.value: Saks Fifth Avenue is the flagship department store at 611 Fifth Avenue across from Rockefeller Center.

description.value: Saks Fifth Avenue is the flagship department store at 611 Fifth Avenue New York, NY 10022. It faces Rockefeller Center and St. Patrick's Cathedral in Midtown. Its holiday windows and light show draw crowds from late November, so visit early in the day.
